name: reach-out-film
description: Reach out: a tile-mural ad for Kingdom Sites custom apps. A hand reaches out of the illusion, the mirrors become a laptop, one tap makes an app. Built in Remotion.

scripts.draft: npm run mix && remotion render Mural build/picture-540x960.mp4 --scale=0.5 --concurrency=8 --muted && ffmpeg -y -v error -i build/picture-540x960.mp4 -i build/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest ../draft/reach-out-draft-540x960.mp4
scripts.final: npm run mix && remotion render Mural build/picture-1080x1920.mp4 --concurrency=8 --muted --crf=14 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i build/picture-1080x1920.mp4 -i build/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest ../final/reach-out-v8-1080x1920.mp4
